note: Hand-declared, and checked against the leaves. The year totals Book IV writes for itself, in pencil, from leaf 114 on. What a total leaves out is a judgement the book makes and no script can, so it is declared here with the reason; that the figure is on the sheet is not trusted to a person, and `npm run lean` fails if `match` is not found between that sheet's \sheet{} and the next. Lean then proves that the reader's receipts for the year equal the written total plus what is declared left out, to the cent.

omits.why: Fire insurance on the 1957 Buick, receipted 22 December 1962. The book leaves insurance money out of its sums — the rule leaf 116 wrote down — and batch 13's note on leaf 152 says this is the only 1962 receipt the total does not count.
